object.description: A document's manifest declares as parents a loaded document, a parent folder path, an absolute path to another project's document and a network share. Open the link picker on one of its objects while recording each path Mellon asks the file system for. Expected: no path outside the repository is asked for, and the picker lists exactly the loaded parent's objects and the document's other objects.
